boss.relicweave.gravity_maw.phase1: The Maw's pull weakens... and then it hungers for debris.
boss.relicweave.gravity_maw.phase2: The Gravity Maw rains stone from above!
guide.relicweave.boss.gravity_maw: Stand beside a Gravity Anchor to resist the pull, then hit it while gorged. Step out of the ring before it repulses.
advancements.relicweave.vestige.gravity_: Defeat the Gravity Maw in the Inverted Vault.
boss.relicweave.starforged_colossus.phas: The Colossus roars, its forge blazing.
The Colossus calls down the stars!
guide.relicweave.boss.starforged_colossu: Its armor holds until it overheats: flip a vent lever then. Jump the slam, hide behind cover from the heat pulse.
advancements.relicweave.vestige.starforg: Defeat the Starforged Colossus in the Foundry of Falling Stars.
message.relicweave.colossus.armored: Its armor shrugs off your blows. Wait for it to overheat, then pull a vent lever.
message.relicweave.colossus.vulnerable: Vent Burst! The Colossus is exposed!
